text: Introduction: Dentistry education of China Medical University was started in 1948. In 1979, dentistry program was established and the dentistry department was founded in 1985. Then in 1988, it developed into the School of Dentistry and Oral Health. The dentistry program of CMU is the first-level characteristic discipline of Liaoning province, the pilot program of college comprehensive reform of Liaoning province. The Stomatology Teaching Center is the model center of Liaoning provincial experimental teaching as well as the clinical skills training center for the college students in Liaoning province. Periodontics and oral and maxillofacial surgery are the key clinical specialized subject construction projects of national Health Development Planning Commission. It passed the stomatology accreditation organized by Ministry of Education on December, 2014 and ranked No. 9 in the evaluation of Ministry of Education on colleges’ stomatology program in the whole country on 2022.Main Courses: Basic Medicine, Basic Science of Stomatology, Clinical Science of Stomatology, Human Anatomy, Histology and Embryology, , Diseases of the Oral Mucosa, Oral and Maxillofacial Diagnostic Imaging, Pathophysiology, Periodontology, Pediatric Dentistry, Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Prosthetic Dentistry, OrthodonticsGraduation and Degree Issued: Students who has completed all the required courses and passed all the examinations will be allowed to graduate. Students who meet the requirement of Degree Awarding Committee will be awarded the degree of Bachelor of Dental Surgery. Fee Structure Tuition Fee: RMB 40000Physical examination: 700RMB;Residence permit: 800RMB per year;Medical insurance: 800RMB per year;Books: around 3,000RMB for the first year (CMU will return the extra or charge more from the students according to the actual cost);Accommodation: 7500RMB per year for a single room.Cost of Living: RMB 700~RMB 1,000
